banner.title: THE REGISTRY PROMOTION DEF NAME FIX - the bare monster keys, the wsgRoles service mask, and the three MM1 field rides

MonsterDef gains the wsgRoles service mask - 1 normal, 2 mount, 4 pack - the roles derived from the wsgmount.h catalog pins: 13 mount rows, 15 pack rows, all 18 carrying the normal bit (the wild horse normal only, the elephants trained only, the sled dog a pack team).
